title: Ergo-LR v2.0.0 (light theme)
notes:
Ergo-LR layout in AZERTY, with special characters, enhanced with parts from TailorKey
=====================================================================================

- Ergo-LR: description, motivation, initial layout -> see https://github.com/rdeneau/kalamine#ergolr
- TailorKey: AutoShift, HRM, Symbol layers (revised) -> see https://sites.google.com/view/tailorkey/moergo/glove80
- Special characters:
  - available in the 1dk and 2dk layers
  - those that do not have Alt+XXX shortcuts in Windows require an AutoHotKey script that maps the F14/F15/F18 key combinations to Unicode codes—see AHK script below

History
-------

- v1.2.5
  - 2nd key for Undo in Cursor layer → Voice moved to 3dk
- v1.2.4
  - Symbol layer: ~ ; , : . { } 
- v1.2.3
  - Add ✓ and ✗ in 1-dk layers for the K and X keys
  - Add ✔️ and ✖️ in 2-dk layers for the K and X keys
- v1.2.2
  - Add ★ and ✱ in n-dk layers for the Y key
- v1.2.1
  - Swap some chars in 1dk and 2dk layers for consistency with Base and Symbol layers
  - Add ASCII box/tree chars
- v1.2.0
  - Simplify RGB underglow
  - Increase AS tapping term from 190 to 250 ms
  - Improve Cursor layer (wip)
- v1.1.6
  - Fix [`] and [```] on Symbol layer
- v1.1.5
  - Set [F1], [F6], [F7] combos with 2 stack keys (for 1 finger)
  - Symbol layer: place { } / \ at J M L R position, remove [ ] at 6 7 positions (no duplicate)
  - Remove MEH combos
- v1.1.4
  - Adjust Base layer 1st column: [Esc], [Caps], [Tab], [Shift], [Ctrl], [Magic] -> Almost the regular positions, except [Caps] and [Tab] swapped
  - Put [F1]..[F12] on the num row in the Lower layer
  - Swap [œ]/[ô], [î]/[ï], [ù]/[û] in the 1dk and 2dk layers
  - Place [Context Menu] at the [Win] position in the 1dk layer
  - Symbol layer:
    - add "[" / "]" at N6 N7 (symmetry with "(" / ")" of the base layer)
    - add [```] next to [`]
    - place [/] and [\] on [J] and [L] positions, to let [,] and [.] at their base position
- v1.1.3
  - Place () in the 6 and 7 keys
  - Swap {} with () keys in the Symbol layer
  - Change backgrounds to fit the light theme, used in Slides for printing
    https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1OIAwxQr9Fmw_g404qKTTSOAyGGs8OsB8os9ro9SexlI/edit?usp=sharing
  - Add emojis: 🤖 [.], ⚠️ [,]
- v1.1.2
  - Adjust the key background as RGB underglow color for Killix
  - Swap [Esc] and [CapsLock], more similar to regular keyboards
  - Add [æ] and [Æ] to 1dk and 2dk layers respectively
- v1.1.1
  - Fix 🚨
- v1.1.0
  - Change AutoShift and HRM layer activation keys on the Base layer: respectively [A]+[S] and [H]+[R]
  - Fix Tab on 1dk layer, using AHK
  - Allow [Esc]aping 1dk and 2dk -> Move [â] above [à] (LH), Put [Esc] on the 1dk letter (meaning 3 taps == no tap)
  - Improve AHK script to handle code point combination: F18 for U-xxxx U+FE0F, F22 for U-xx U+FE0F U+20E3
  - Add 3dk layer dedicated to emojis
  - Add additional symbols in the 2dk layer (fat arrows, other bullets, triangles)
- v1.0.9
  - Combos: remove TailorKey combos, add F6 and F7 combos, add left/right MEH combos
- v1.0.8
  - Fix F15 special characters on the 2dk layer
- v1.0.7
  - Fix Autoshift layer 1dk
  - Add keys to choose the initial layer: E -> AutoShift, N -> HRM
- v1.0.6
  - Fix autoshift layer: add missing control keys via the Base layer
  - Cursor layer: add Paste as plain text (W)
- v1.0.5
  - Change punctuation keys: minus_under (-/_), qmark_excl (?/!)
  - Move Autoshift layer: 1st layer
- v1.0.4
  - AHK macros send F14 or F15, wait 25 ms, then...
  - Fix [0] key
  - Use FR_ keycode prefix

Fn_Unicode_Symbol.ahk
----------------------

```autohotkey
#Requires AutoHotkey v2.0
#SingleInstance Force
ListLines 0
ProcessSetPriority "High"

; Pre-instantiate global hooks to eliminate instantiation latency
global ih2 := InputHook("L2 T1")
global ih4 := InputHook("L4 T1")
global ih5 := InputHook("L5 T1")
global ih8 := InputHook("L4 T1")

global asEmoji := FmtU("FE0F") ; https://symbl.cc/en/FE0F/
global enclose := FmtU("20E3") ; https://symbl.cc/en/20E3/

F14:: ProcessUnicodeInput(ih4, 4)                   ; 4-hex-letter Unicode code point (e.g. F14+275D -> ❝)
F15:: ProcessUnicodeInput(ih5, 5)                   ; 5-hex-letter Unicode code point (e.g. F15+1F448 -> 👈)
F18:: ProcessUnicodeInput(ih8, 4, asEmoji)          ; 4-hex-letter Unicode code point then U+FE0F (e.g. F18+2699 -> U+2699 U+FE0F -> ⚙️)
F22:: ProcessUnicodeInput(ih2, 2, asEmoji, enclose) ; 2-hex-letter Unicode code point then U+FE0F then U+20E3 (e.g. F22+30 -> U+30 U+FE0F U+20E3 -> 0️⃣)

; Generic handler: reads a hex code point of the given length (2, 4, 5) and sends the matching Unicode character
; extraCodeN parameters are used with emojis
ProcessUnicodeInput(hookObject, length, extraCode1 := "", extraCode2 := "") {
    hookObject.Start()
    hookObject.Wait()

    ; Regex: case insensitive, length quantifier built dynamically
    if RegExMatch(hookObject.Input, "i)^([0-9a-f]{" length "})$", &match) {
        mainCode := FmtU(match[1])
        Send(mainCode extraCode1 extraCode2)
    } else {
        ; Fallback: replay the raw input unchanged
        Send(hookObject.Input)
    }
}

FmtU(code) {
    return (code != "") ? "{U+" code "}" : ""
}
```

holdTaps.description:
AutoShift Helper - &AS main macro is chained to &AS_HT hold tap and &AS_Shifted macro. For faster typists, it is recommended to decrease the tapping-term-ms value. A suggested value is 135 ms.
More: https://github.com/nickcoutsos/keymap-editor/wiki/Autoshift-using-ZMK-behaviors
